svg.title: G03 DEEP SPACE BEAM CARTOGRAPHER engineering architecture
svg.desc: Complex near-field and calibrated far-field branches share configuration and chain evidence, then produce supported pattern metrics. G/T remains a separate output requiring qualified noise temperature.
